title: Ember Orchard: The Herbalist's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the restorative field formula; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
